metadata.title: CAR-T cell therapy: current limitations and potential strategies

units.text: CAR-T cell therapy: current limitations and potential strategies

Current challenges in CAR-T cell therapy include (A) antigen escape, (B) on-target off-tumor effects, (C) trafficking and infiltration of tumors, (D) the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, and (E) CAR-T cell-associated toxicities.
The antigen binding domain is the portion of the CAR that confers target antigen specificity.
the malignant cells of a significant portion of patients treated with these CAR-T cells display either partial or complete loss of target antigen expression.
This phenomenon is known as antigen escape.
many strategies are now relying on targeting multiple antigens.
